responses:

2. Take the book to the counter – Bring the book to the librarian or self-checkout machine.
3. Show your library card – Scan or provide your library membership card.
4. Check out the book – The librarian scans the book and records the loan.
5. Get the due date – Check when the book must be returned.
6. Take the book home – Keep it safe and return it before the due date.

responses: TAR UMT has five dining spots: Red Bricks Cafeteria (Block G, near Gate 3), Yum Yum Cafeteria (near Block L), Casuarina Cafe (East Campus, near Block SC, via Gate 7), Heritage Kitchen (inside the Club House at the Sports Complex), and FM Café (near CITC, Gate 2). The Library also has a small cafe corner called Sunnydew. If you tell me which building you're near, I can point you to the closest one.

For a quick bite near the Main Entrance or Library, try Yum Yum Cafeteria or the Sunnydew corner inside the Library. Near the Sports Complex, Heritage Kitchen at the Club House is convenient. If you're on the East Campus side, Casuarina Cafe near Block SC is your closest option.

responses: Based on the map: The Main Hall (Dewan Tunku Abdul Rahman / DTAR) and TAR UMT Arena are in the center of West Campus, right past the Main Entrance (Gate 1). Admissions (DACE) and Finance (DFIN) are in Bangunan Tun Tan Siew Sin near Gate 2. The East Campus (Blocks SA-SG) is located across the road, accessible via Gate 7.

Here are key directions: Student Affairs (DSA) is at Block B Ground Floor (near Gate 1). Cafeterias include Red Bricks (Block G, near Gate 3), Yum Yum (near Block L), and Casuarina Cafe (Block SC, East Campus). The Sports Complex, Swimming Pool, and Hostel are in the northern area near Gate 5.

To find a specific block: Blocks A to Z, and PA to PZ are in the West Campus. Blocks SA to SG are in the East Campus. The IT Centre (CITC) is near Gate 2 and Bus Stops 1-5. The Health Centre (Klinik LOW) is at the Ground Floor of Block V near Gate 4. Please refer to the visual campus map for exact walking paths.
